short_title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade daily countertop organization with a wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder crafted from solid brass and designed to save space in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. Part of the Mambo collection, it supports transitional bathroom hardware looks and coordinates with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- Multiple designer finish options available to coordinate with your bathroom
- Includes installation hardware

Specs:
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Overall size: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 4.7 in H
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Included: Toothbrush holder and installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
